龙国篇龙国篇第十五章眼见不为实
硝烟如同被无形之手缓缓抚平，渐渐地在广袤的战场上消散殆尽，露出了它原本的面目，一片狼藉，断壁残垣与焦土交织，昔日热闹非凡的战场，此刻却沉寂得令人心悸。
夕阳如血，斜洒在这片废墟之上，为这片死亡之地披上了一层悲壮的红纱，远处，两道身影静静地躺在冰冷的地面上，宛如雕塑，与周围的死寂融为一体。
他们身上的衣物破烂不堪，布条随风摇曳，仿佛在低语着战斗中的惨烈。
叶恒，他的身体无力地摊开着，脸上却意外地绽放出一抹释然的笑，而这，我这个作者也不明白他究竟为何而笑，难道？是死而后生的感触？
相反，另一旁的艾露就不一样了，她身上的铠甲早已粉碎，她伤似异常严重，完全可用奄奄一息也不为过，她偷偷地用余光打量着叶恒，那眼神中既有疑惑也有一丝不易察觉的敬佩，她的心中波澜起伏，不禁在嘴角勾起一抹细微的弧度，仿佛是对叶恒那份超乎常人的坚韧与神秘能力的微妙回应。
随后，她轻轻开口，声音中带着一丝不解与无奈：“我还是不明白，你一个B级武神，究竟是如何承受住我全力施展的‘怒炎焚尽’，甚至够全身而退，毫发无伤？”
叶恒：“你真的想知道？”
艾露犹豫了一下，最终还是摇了摇头，眼中闪过一丝释然：“算了，知道也没意思，我已经证明了你的实力，呵......只够了“
叶恒望着艾露那双闪烁着复杂情绪的眸子，也不想瞒着艾露，有点不好意思的轻声道：“其实，刚才与你命技正面交锋的，不过是我的一个分身罢了，一个融合了雷电与光芒力量的分身，而那个所谓的破绽，也是我刻意为之。”
“你......”
艾露也不知该说些什么，但总有一股气始终憋在心里，顿时哑口无言。
叶恒看着艾露的样子，心中微微一痛，但他还是硬下了心肠：“你......没事吧？”
只见艾露沉默不语，似乎并不打算回应叶恒的问题，而叶恒见此情形，也并未继续追问下去，因为他心里很清楚，每个人都会有属于自己不为人知的秘密，如果过度地去探究别人的隐私，不仅可能得不到想要的答案，反而会给自己惹来不必要的麻烦。
然而，回想起之前那场激烈的战斗，叶恒心中的疑惑却始终无法平息，在交手的过程中，他明显感觉到艾露对艾希姐手下留情了，每当她的攻击即将击中艾希的时候，艾露总会有意地减轻力道和武神力，仿佛是在刻意避免给对方造成实质性的伤害。
终于，按捺不住内心的好奇，叶恒还是轻轻地开口问道：“你……为什么每一次要攻击到希儿时都刻意减轻力道与武神力呢？”
听到这个问题，艾露缓缓地闭上了双眼，深深地叹了一口气，似乎陷入了某种回忆之中。
过了好一会儿，她才冷冷地说道：“我为什么要告诉你？你以为你是谁啊！”
面对艾露冷漠的态度，叶恒并没有生气，只是不屑地笑了笑，嘲讽道：“哼，都已经死到临头了，还在这里故作神秘、假装强硬。”
听到这话，艾露猛地睁开眼睛，眼神中闪过一丝愤怒，但很快又恢复了平静。

她咬了咬牙，像是经过一番挣扎之后做出了决定，语气略微缓和地说：“好吧，告诉你也无妨。
但是……这个秘密只能由你一个人知晓，我担心……小妹她承受不了真相。”
叶恒嘴角微微上扬，露出一抹不屑的笑容，轻哼一声道：“呵……这有什么接受不了的！”
他那满不在乎的态度，仿佛对即将到来的事情毫不在意。
一旁的艾露见状，神色瞬间变得严肃起来，她紧紧地盯着叶恒的眼睛，郑重其事地问道：“你到底答不答应？如果你不答应，那我就绝对不会说出来。”
然而，叶恒那颗强烈的好奇心此时已经被完全勾了起来，面对艾露的威胁，他几乎没有丝毫犹豫，想也不想便随口应道：“好啦好啦，我答应就是了！”
说完还潇洒地一挥手，似乎觉得这只是一件微不足道的小事。
紧接着，叶恒像是想起了什么似的，又补充了一句：“君子一言，驷马难追！
我既然答应了你，那就肯定会做到的！”
他一脸自信满满，仿佛自己所说的每一个字都如同金科玉律一般不容置疑。
艾露悠悠地睁开双眼，那眼眸之中仿佛弥漫着一层厚重的雾气，尽显深深的疲惫与无尽的无奈。
她艰难地转动眼珠，目光缓缓落在了叶恒身上，嘴角微微上扬，牵扯出一抹苦涩至极的笑容，宛如秋霜打过的残花，令人心生怜悯。
叶恒同样凝视着艾露，他的眼神深邃如海，其中快速地闪过一丝难以言喻的复杂情绪，似惊、似疑、又似怜。
沉默许久之后，艾露仿佛用尽全身力气才终于打破这片让人几乎要喘不过气来的死寂。
她的嗓音低沉而又沙哑，宛如从幽深山谷底部缓缓传出一般，每一个字都像是承载着无尽沉重的往昔记忆。
“其实，我和小妹并不是亲姐妹。”
艾露的声音低沉而缓慢，仿佛每一个字都承载着沉重的过去。
叶恒微微皱眉，他并没有想到会有这样的转折，他看着艾露，等待着她的下文。
艾露深吸了一口气，继续说道：“我们既是孤儿，也是拜在露米希师傅门下的弟子，也是她老人家最得以的弟子和唯一的三徒弟，那时候我们都还年轻，对未来充满了憧憬和期待。
可是，战争却摧毁了我们的梦想，让我们不得不面对残酷的现实，我们相识于战火之中，艾希，那个比我小了五岁的妹妹，御山关一战师傅大获全胜但师傅确留下了一身重病，我看着师傅抱中的那个婴儿，她那通红的小脸很是可爱，不哭不闹的看着我。”

她真的真的很可爱！”
content_en:
Dragon Kingdom Arc Dragon Kingdom Arc Chapter 15 Seeing is not believing
As if being slowly smoothed by invisible hands, the smoke gradually dissipated on the vast battlefield, revealing its original appearance. It was a mess, with broken walls and scorched earth intertwined. The bustling battlefield in the past was now so quiet that it was heart-stopping.
The setting sun was like blood, slanting over the ruins, covering the land of death with a tragic red veil. In the distance, two figures lay quietly on the cold ground, like sculptures, blending into the surrounding deathly silence.
The clothes on their bodies were in tatters, and the strips of cloth swayed in the wind, as if whispering the horror of the battle.
Ye Heng's body was spread out helplessly, but a relieved smile unexpectedly broke out on his face. And this, the author, I don't understand why he was smiling, could it be? Is it the feeling of death and rebirth?
On the contrary, Ellu on the other side was different. The armor on her body had long been shattered. Her injuries seemed to be extremely serious. It was not an exaggeration to say that she was dying. She secretly looked at Ye Heng with her peripheral vision. There were doubts and a hint of unnoticeable admiration in her eyes. Her heart was filled with ups and downs. She couldn't help but raise a slight arc at the corner of her mouth, as if it was a subtle response to Ye Heng's extraordinary tenacity and mysterious ability.
Then, she spoke softly, with a hint of confusion and helplessness in her voice: "I still don't understand, how on earth can you, a B-level Martial God, withstand the 'Burning Flames' that I used with all my strength, and even be able to escape unscathed?"
Ye Heng: "Do you really want to know?"
Ailu hesitated for a moment, then finally shook his head, a trace of relief flashed in his eyes: "Forget it, it's pointless to know. I've already proven your strength, huh... that's just enough."
Ye Heng looked at Ai Lu's eyes flashing with complex emotions, and did not want to hide it from Ai Lu. He said softly and a little embarrassedly: "Actually, the one who had a head-on confrontation with your life skills just now was just a clone of mine, a clone that merged the power of thunder and lightning. And that so-called flaw was also deliberately done by me."
"You..."
Ellu didn't know what to say, but there was always a breath that was always held in her heart, and she was suddenly speechless.
Ye Heng looked at Ai Lu's appearance and felt a slight pain in his heart, but he still hardened his heart: "Are you... okay?"
Ai Lu remained silent, seemingly not intending to respond to Ye Heng's question. Seeing this, Ye Heng did not continue to ask questions, because he knew very well that everyone would have their own unknown secrets. If he explored other people's privacy too much, not only might he not get the answers he wanted, but he would also cause unnecessary trouble for himself.
However, recalling the fierce battle before, the doubts in Ye Heng's heart could not be calmed down. During the fight, he clearly felt that Ailu was merciful to sister Ai Xi. Whenever her attack was about to hit Ai Xi, Ailu would always intentionally reduce her strength and martial arts power, as if to avoid causing substantial damage to the opponent.
Finally, unable to suppress his inner curiosity, Ye Heng softly asked: "Why...why do you deliberately reduce your strength and martial power every time you want to attack Xi'er?"
Hearing this question, Elu slowly closed his eyes and sighed deeply, seeming to be caught in some kind of memory.
After a while, she said coldly: "Why should I tell you? Who do you think you are!"
Faced with Ai Lu's indifferent attitude, Ye Heng was not angry. He just smiled disdainfully and said mockingly: "Humph, you are already on the verge of death, and you are still here pretending to be mysterious and tough."
Hearing this, Elu opened his eyes suddenly, a trace of anger flashed in his eyes, but he quickly regained his composure.
She gritted her teeth, as if she had made a decision after some struggle, and said in a slightly gentle tone: "Okay., it doesn’t hurt to tell you.
But... this secret can only be known by you. I'm worried... my little sister won't be able to bear the truth. "
The corners of Ye Heng's mouth raised slightly, showing a disdainful smile, and he snorted softly: "Heh... there is nothing unacceptable about this! "
His nonchalant attitude seemed to have no regard for what was about to happen.
When Ai Lu saw this, her expression instantly became serious. She stared closely into Ye Heng's eyes and asked solemnly: "Do you agree or not? If you don't agree, then I will never say it. "
However, Ye Heng's strong curiosity had been completely aroused at this time. Faced with Ai Lu's threat, he barely hesitated at all and responded casually without thinking: "Okay, okay, I just agree! "
After saying that, he waved his hand coolly, as if he thought it was just a trivial matter.
Immediately afterwards, Ye Heng seemed to have remembered something and added: "A gentleman's words are hard to chase!
Since I promised you, I will definitely do it! "
He looked confident, as if every word he said was as unquestionable as a golden rule.
Ai Lu opened her eyes leisurely, and her eyes seemed to be filled with a thick layer of mist, showing deep exhaustion and endless helplessness.
She rolled her eyes with difficulty, and her eyes slowly fell on Ye Heng. The corners of her mouth raised slightly, revealing a bitter smile, which was like a broken flower beaten by autumn frost, which made people feel pity.
Ye Heng also stared at Ai Lu. His eyes were as deep as the sea, and a trace of indescribable complex emotions flashed through them quickly, like shock, suspicion, and pity.
After a long silence, Elu seemed to have used all his strength to finally break the almost breathless silence.
Her voice was low and hoarse, as if coming slowly from the bottom of a deep valley, and every word seemed to carry endless and heavy memories of the past.
"Actually, my little sister and I are not biological sisters. "
Ellu's voice was low and slow, as if every word carried a heavy past.
Ye Heng frowned slightly. He did not expect such a turn. He looked at Ai Lu, waiting for her next words.
Ellu took a deep breath and continued: "We are both orphans and disciples of Master Lumishi. We are also her best disciples and the only three disciples. At that time, we were all still young and full of longing and expectations for the future.
However, the war destroyed our dreams and forced us to face the cruel reality. We met in the flames of war, Ai Xi, a sister who was five years younger than me. The master won a great victory in the battle of Yushanguan, but the master did leave behind a serious illness. I looked at the baby in the master's arms. Her little red face was very cute, and she looked at me without crying or fussing. "
She is really really cute! "
